searchText: opened eips #12644 to raise MAX_VERIFY_GAS from 100k to 300k. groth16 verify is ~236k and pq sigs go up to ~276k, so 100k doesn't fit them. nethermind already defaults to 300k. devnet-2 prs, all green: <@543900561460822016> geth #36095 (new cap) and #36096 <@281967554572976128> ethrex #7522 (new cap) and #7523, #7524, #7525 reth needs Rimeeeeee/eips#8 first, pinged them on github would be great to get eyes on them 🙏
